parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4 that have both a drug_mechanism entry and a compound_structures entry with canonical_smiles. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism and to compound_structures using INNER JOIN. Join drug_mechanism to target_dictionary using LEFT JOIN so target_chembl_id and target_name may be null. Return DISTINCT rows for chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name.
